source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: This unit may reroll melee **wound rolls** of 1. With the **[assault doctrine](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines)** active for this unit, it may reroll any melee **wound rolls** instead.
